metadata.name: AQF 100+ semi-curated benchmark workload
metadata.description: Generated AQF workload for journal-scale evaluation.

queries.description: Retrieve all patient records in which the demographic attribute gender is recorded as Male, in order to define a gender-specific patient cohort.
Identify all patient records in which birth date is earlier than 01-01-1970, to enable age-based demographic stratification.
Retrieve all patient records in which nationality is documented as Brazilian, for demographic and population-based subgroup analysis.
Retrieve all patient records in which educational level is documented as Higher education, for demographic and social-determinant profiling.
Retrieve all clinical records in which primary diagnosis corresponds to breast cancer, to define a diagnosis-specific outpatient cohort.
Identify all records in which secondary diagnosis is recorded as hypertension, to capture clinically relevant comorbidity alongside the principal disease.
Retrieve all clinical records in which topography corresponds to colon, thereby identifying cases associated with the specified anatomical site.
Retrieve all records in which staging is documented as Stage III, for severity-oriented cohort derivation and treatment pathway review.
Retrieve all records in which procedure is documented as biopsy, to identify patients who underwent that specific diagnostic intervention.
Retrieve all treatment records in which chemotherapy schema corresponds to FOLFOX, in order to identify a regimen-specific chemotherapy cohort.
Retrieve all records in which radiotherapy fields indicate pelvic field irradiation, to identify patients treated with the specified radiotherapy field configuration.
Retrieve all records in which duration of treatment exceeds 90 days, to identify patients exposed to prolonged treatment courses.
Retrieve all records in which issue date is later than 01-01-2022, to support time-bounded clinical record selection.
Identify all records in which date of discharge falls within January 2023, for temporal analysis of discharge activity.
Retrieve all records in which date of beginning of chemotherapy is later than 01-06-2021, in order to identify patients starting chemotherapy in the defined time window.
Retrieve all records in which date of pathological identification falls within the calendar year 2020, for diagnostic timing and case-identification review.
Retrieve all records in which primary diagnosis is breast cancer and procedure is biopsy, thereby identifying a clinically meaningful diagnosis–procedure cohort.

queries.query_name: Patients older than 60 with lung cancer
queries.description: Identify all patients older than 60 years based on birth date or age derivation, whose primary diagnosis is lung cancer, to define an age-conditioned disease cohort.

queries.query_name: São Paulo patients on FOLFOX treatment
queries.description: Retrieve all patient records in which the demographic location attribute state is São Paulo and chemotherapy schema is FOLFOX, to identify a geographically restricted treatment cohort.

queries.query_name: Stage III biopsy cohort with chemotherapy beginning after 01-01-2022
queries.description: Retrieve all records in which staging is Stage III, procedure is biopsy, and date of beginning of chemotherapy is later than 01-01-2022, thereby defining a temporally constrained multi-context clinical cohort.
